Its lesson slugs carry the pp3 prefixes (pp3u1-1, …), so none of its ids can meet another course's. Lesson titles, page offsets and units come from its own S0 lesson map, approved at G0.

widgets.stem: $A$ and $B$ lie on circle $M$. Set the arc $AB$ facing $C$ to $60°$, and read the inscribed angle.
widgets.instrument: Spec example {"ask":"inscribed","target":35} — A, B and C all drag on a circle; the arc AB that C faces and the angle ∠ACB are shown together and stay in a 2:1 ratio through every drag. ask ∈ central | inscribed. target must be a multiple of 5 (inscribed 5–175, central 10–350). This is the inscribed-angle theorem as a thing the student does with their hands — prefer it to any explanation of that theorem.

reading_fields.ask: 'central' or 'inscribed' — which angle the target is

diagnostics.predicate_meaning: Gave the inscribed angle where the central angle or arc was asked for — the arc is double
diagnostics.misconception_label: Inscribed angle doubled instead of halved
diagnostics.misconception_description: Takes the inscribed angle to equal its arc, or twice it, rather than half.
